info.title: Showcase Status API
info.description: Minimal OpenAPI document for the showcase's own health probe. Referenced by the StatusOpenApiConnector declarative instance (src/system/connectors/index.ts) as a package-relative file path — the #3016 / ADR-0096 spec form resolved and confined to this package's root at boot. NOTE (#7538): a static document cannot follow the port this instance actually bound, so `servers[0].url` below is only the documentation default. The connector supplies an env-resolved `providerConfig.baseUrl` (src/system/self-url.ts), and createOpenApiConnector resolves `config.baseUrl ?? document.servers[0].url` — so the value below is overridden on every dispatch.

get.description: Returns the running server's health status.
